cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that current human-feedback and AI-feedback alignment can induce sycophancy, while execution-based environments can be bypassed by unconstrained agents through test evasion. It introduces OOM-RL, which deploys agents in non-stationary, high-friction live markets and uses real execution costs, slippage, and capital depletion as externally imposed negative signals, then reports a 20-month longitudinal evolution from a high-turnover sycophantic baseline to a liquidity-aware architecture formalized as STDAW and RO-Lock. The authors state the main contribution is treating externally imposed economic consequences as an epistemic constraint, not demonstrating investment capability.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作把真实资源耗竭视为一种客观物理约束，为智能体对齐提供了不同于人工评分的外部信号来源，可能启发将现实代价纳入开发流程的通用范式。
keyPointsEn: OOM-RL uses live trading losses as an externally imposed negative gradient instead of human feedback signals
The system evolved over about 20 months and was formalized as STDAW and a Byzantine-inspired uni-directional state lock, RO-Lock
During the final 94-trading-day window, the annualized Sharpe ratio was approximately 2.06, an observational result
cards.limitations: 论文明确说明，财务结果是观察性的且受时间窗口限制，不能解释为持续投资阿尔法存在的证据，也不能作为 STDAW 贡献的因果估计；核心贡献在于对齐范式的提出，而非投资绩效或机制因果验证。
cards.titleEn: OOM-RL: Aligning Multi-Agent Systems via Real Capital Loss Constraints
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work treats real resource depletion as an objective physical constraint, offering an external signal source for agent alignment different from human ratings, and may inspire general paradigms that embed real-world costs into development pipelines.
keyPoints: OOM-RL 以实盘亏损作为外部负梯度，替代人为反馈信号
系统经历约20个月演进，并形式化为 STDAW 与基于拜占庭思路的单向状态锁 RO-Lock
最后94个交易日观测窗口中年化夏普比率约为2.06，属观察性结果
cards.summary: 论文主张现有人类反馈与AI反馈对齐易诱导模型谄媚，而基于执行的环境又可能被无约束智能体通过测试规避绕过。作者提出OOM-RL，把智能体部署到非平稳、高摩擦的实盘市场，用真实执行成本、滑点和资金耗竭作为外部施加的负面信号，并在20个月纵向观察中记录系统从高换手谄媚基线演化为流动性感知架构，后期形式化为STDAW与RO-Lock。作者自述主要贡献是把外部经济后果作为智能体开发的认知约束，而非证明投资能力。
cards.originalTitle: OOM-RL: Out-of-Money Reinforcement Learning Market-Driven Alignment for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes using capital depletion in live financial markets as an externally imposed negative gradient for multi-agent system development, instead of human feedback that may induce sycophancy, and documents the resulting STDAW workflow and RO-Lock state lock.
cards.description: 提出用实盘金融市场的资金亏损作为外部负梯度来约束多智能体系统开发，以替代易致谄媚的人为反馈，并记录了由此形成的STDAW工作流与RO-Lock状态锁机制。
cards.limitationsEn: The paper explicitly states that the financial results are observational and temporally bounded, should not be interpreted as evidence of persistent investment alpha, and are not a causal estimate of STDAW's contribution; the core contribution is the alignment paradigm, not validated investment performance or mechanism causality.
cards.title: 以真实资金亏损约束多智能体系统对齐的OOM-RL范式

cards.summaryEn: Deep models should theoretically outperform shallow ones, but existing empirical asset pricing literature shows stronger benchmarks for shallow models. The authors use residual learning to deepen neural networks while preserving shallow model information, improving out-of-sample performance. The deep residual model's value-weighted long-short portfolio out-of-sample Sharpe ratio is 2.07, higher than the shallow counterpart's 1.92 and more than twice the deep feedforward model's 0.89. The authors argue model depth is a source of additional economic value in asset pricing and that residual learning can deepen other neural-network-based asset pricing models with intermediate layers.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为量化资产定价提供了新的建模思路：通过残差学习将现有浅层模型平滑地扩展为深层模型，从而可能获取额外的经济价值。同时，该方法不限于特定模型，若其他神经网络资产定价模型含有中间层，也可借鉴此设计进行加深，这为构建更复杂的资产定价模型提供了可操作的方向。
keyPointsEn: The deep residual asset pricing model's value-weighted long-short portfolio out-of-sample Sharpe ratio is 2.07, higher than the shallow model's 1.92 and the deep feedforward model's 0.89.
Residual learning allows neural networks to go deeper by preserving and refining shallow counterparts, mitigating the underperformance of deep models.
The authors argue model depth is a source of additional economic value in asset pricing and that this design offers a path to scale native 'large asset pricing models'.
cards.limitations: 研究基于作者选取的特定数据集、模型结构和回测区间，结果反映的是样本外回测表现而非实盘收益。夏普比率差异未报告统计显著性，且未讨论交易成本、容量约束、模型风险与过拟合可能。残差学习对其他资产定价模型的普适性仅属作者推断，尚需独立验证。文中不构成任何投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Residual Learning Deepens Shallow Asset Pricing Models and Improves Out-of-Sample Performance
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study provides a new modeling approach for quantitative asset pricing: residual learning can smoothly extend existing shallow models into deep ones to potentially capture additional economic value. The method is not limited to a specific model; other neural-network-based asset pricing models with intermediate layers could also adopt this deepening design, offering an actionable direction for building more complex asset pricing models.
keyPoints: 深度残差资产定价模型的价值加权多空组合样本外夏普比率为2.07，高于浅层模型的1.92和深度前馈模型的0.89。
残差学习让神经网络在保留浅层模型信息的同时加深，缓解了深层模型表现不如浅层模型的问题。
作者认为模型深度是资产定价中额外经济价值的来源，并称该设计可为‘原生大型资产定价模型’的规模化提供路径。
cards.summary: 深层模型理论上应优于浅层模型，但已有资产定价实证文献中浅层模型表现更强。作者通过残差学习使神经网络在保留浅层模型信息的基础上加深，从而提升样本外表现。结果显示，深度残差模型的价值加权多空组合样本外夏普比率为2.07，高于对应的浅层模型1.92，且超过深度前馈模型0.89的两倍。作者认为模型深度是资产定价中额外经济价值的来源，并指出残差学习可推广到其他含中间层的神经网络资产定价模型。
cards.originalTitle: Residual Learning in Empirical Asset Pricing
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes residual learning to deepen neural network asset pricing models by preserving and refining shallow counterparts, addressing the finding that deep feedforward models can underperform. Its value lies in offering a design to add economic value through model depth and a path toward scaling asset pricing models.
cards.description: 该研究提出用残差学习加深资产定价神经网络，使浅层模型通过保留并精炼自身信息实现深度化，解决了深层前馈模型表现反而更弱的问题；其价值在于提供了提升模型深度经济价值的设计思路和规模化路径。
cards.limitationsEn: The results are based on the authors' chosen dataset, model structure, and backtest period, reflecting out-of-sample backtest performance rather than live returns. Statistical significance of Sharpe ratio differences is not reported, and trading costs, capacity constraints, model risk, and overfitting are not discussed. The generalizability of residual learning to other asset pricing models is the authors' conjecture and requires independent verification. This does not constitute investment advice.
cards.title: 残差学习将浅层资产定价模型深度显著提升样本外表现

cards.summaryEn: The work argues that LLM reasoning is often treated as a monolithic capability, and binary preference supervision fails to capture partial progress or fine-grained reasoning quality. The authors propose CU-DPO, which replaces binary labels with continuous utility scores and proves a Θ(K log K) sample-complexity improvement over binary preferences with convergence to an entropy-regularized utility-maximizing policy. They report strategy-selection accuracy improving from 35-46% to 68-78% across seven base models, downstream reasoning gains up to +6.6 points, and consistent gains on code generation and causal reasoning benchmarks.
cards.whyItMatters: 若连续效用与多策略组合训练有效，可能让偏好优化更细粒度地利用推理过程信号，减少二值标签造成的信息损失，并提升跨分布与跨任务泛化；对数学、代码与因果推理等可分解任务尤其相关。
keyPointsEn: CU-DPO replaces binary preferences with continuous utility scores, decomposing reasoning into a portfolio of K prompt-based cognitive strategies.
Theoretical analysis claims a Θ(K log K) sample-complexity improvement and convergence of DPO to an entropy-regularized utility-maximizing policy.

A two-stage pipeline first selects strategies via best-vs-all comparisons and then refines correct execution with margin-stratified pairs; the authors report 68-78% strategy-selection accuracy across seven base models and up to +6.6 downstream points.
cards.limitations: 证据边界：以上结论与数字均来自作者在arXiv预印本中的报告，尚未经独立复现与同行评审确认。理论证明依赖K种认知策略可分且连续效用可分解等设定，实际任务未必满足。基准增益集中在数学推理，代码生成与因果推理仅称一致提升，未给统一量级。策略选择准确率与下游增益受基座模型、数据分布与评分器质量影响，离群或对抗场景可能失效。
cards.titleEn: Continuous-Utility Direct Preference Optimization Improves Reasoning Strategy Selection
cards.whyItMattersEn: If continuous utility and multi-strategy portfolio training hold up, preference optimization could exploit finer-grained process signals, reduce information loss from binary labels, and improve cross-distribution and cross-task generalization, especially for decomposable tasks such as math, code, and causal reasoning.
keyPoints: CU-DPO将二值偏好替换为连续效用分数，把推理拆解为K种提示式认知策略的效用组合。
理论分析给出Θ(K log K)样本复杂度改进，并证明DPO收敛到熵正则效用最大化策略。
两阶段流程：先用best-vs-all比较做策略选择，再用边际分层对训练正确执行；作者报告七种基座模型策略选择准确率提升至68-78%，下游最高+6.6分。
cards.summary: 该工作指出LLM推理常被当作单一能力，二值偏好监督无法捕捉部分进展与细粒度推理质量。作者提出CU-DPO，以连续效用分数替代二值标签，并证明K策略学习相对二值偏好有Θ(K log K)样本复杂度改进，且DPO收敛到熵正则效用最大化策略。作者报告在数学推理等基准上策略选择准确率从35-46%提升至68-78%，下游推理最高增益+6.6分，并称在代码生成与因果推理上一致提升。
cards.descriptionEn: CU-DPO replaces binary preference labels with continuous utility scores to learn a portfolio of K cognitive strategies, yielding a theoretical Θ(K log K) sample-complexity improvement and reported gains in strategy selection accuracy and downstream performance on math, code, and causal reasoning benchmarks.
cards.description: CU-DPO用连续效用分数替代二值偏好标签，学习K种认知策略组合，理论上获得Θ(K log K)样本复杂度改进，并在数学、代码与因果推理基准上提升策略选择准确率与下游表现。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: all findings and numbers come from the authors' arXiv preprint and have not been independently reproduced or peer-reviewed. The proofs rely on assumptions such as K cognitively distinct strategies and a decomposable continuous utility signal, which real tasks may not satisfy. Benchmark gains center on mathematical reasoning; code generation and causal reasoning are only described as consistently improved without a unified magnitude. Strategy-selection accuracy and downstream gains depend on base models, data distribution, and scorer quality, and may fail in outlier or adversarial settings.
cards.title: 连续效用直接偏好优化提升推理策略选择

cards.summaryEn: The authors present SOTA, an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection that abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. They post-train Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and evaluate on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY. The authors report an 18.3% total return, Sharpe ratio of 1.60, and maximum drawdown of 8.96% over a six-month out-of-sample period, and document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to -2.7%. These are author-reported results requiring independent verification.
cards.whyItMatters: 期权策略选择需同时决定交易哪些合约及如何组合，固定结构策略难以随市场变化切换。SOTA 提供了一种将大动作空间压缩为策略级决策的智能体框架，可能提升策略切换的灵活性。
keyPointsEn: SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions, with deterministic resolvers handling portfolio implementation.
The agent is post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning.
The authors report 18.3% total return, Sharpe ratio of 1.60, and maximum drawdown of 8.96% over a six-month out-of-sample period.
cards.limitations: 评估仅覆盖九只美国大盘股期权和 SPY 的六个月样本外期间，结果依赖特定训练与评估设置。新闻在强化学习中的负面效应来自作者实验记录，未说明跨市场、跨周期的稳健性。未提供交易成本、滑点、流动性约束等细节，因此不能直接外推为实盘表现或投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Option-Implied Return Distribution Guided Option Trading Agent Framework
cards.whyItMattersEn: Option strategy selection requires deciding both which contracts to trade and how to combine them, and fixed-structure strategies struggle to switch as market conditions change. SOTA offers an agentic framework that compresses the large action space into strategy-level decisions, potentially improving flexibility in strategy switching.
keyPoints: SOTA 将大期权宇宙抽象为策略级决策，由确定性解析器处理组合实现。
智能体通过监督微调与强化学习后训练 Qwen3.8-27B。
作者报告六个月样本外总收益 18.3%、夏普 1.60、最大回撤 8.96%。
cards.summary: 作者提出 SOTA，一个面向结构化期权策略选择的智能体交易框架，将庞大的期权宇宙抽象为策略级决策，并由确定性解析器完成组合实现。他们通过监督微调与强化学习后训练 Qwen3.8-27B，在九只美国大盘股期权和 SPY 上评估。作者报告在六个月样本外期间总收益 18.3%、夏普比率 1.60、最大回撤 8.96%，并记录新闻在强化学习中的非对称作用：新闻提升前沿教师轨迹，但保留新闻使样本外收益从 18.3% 降至 -2.7%。上述为作者报告的结果，需独立验证。
cards.originalTitle: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces SOTA, a framework that abstracts thousands of option contracts into strategy-level decisions, with deterministic resolvers handling portfolio implementation to avoid fixed strategy structures. Its novelty lies in using option-implied return distributions to guide a language-model agent in structured option-strategy selection, evaluated against rule-based and machine-learning selectors in the same trading environment.
cards.description: 该工作提出 SOTA 框架，将数千个期权合约抽象为策略级决策，由确定性解析器负责组合实现，从而避免固定策略结构的限制。其新意在于用期权隐含收益分布引导语言模型智能体进行结构化期权策略选择，并在同一交易环境中与规则和机器学习选择器对比。
cards.limitationsEn: Evaluation covers only options on nine U.S. large-cap equities and SPY over a six-month out-of-sample period, and results depend on the specific training and evaluation setup. The negative effect of news during reinforcement learning is an author-reported experimental finding, with no evidence of robustness across markets or cycles. Details on transaction costs, slippage, and liquidity constraints are not provided, so results cannot be directly extrapolated to live performance or treated as investment advice.
cards.title: 选项隐含收益分布引导的期权交易智能体框架

cards.summaryEn: Financial institutions often use deterministic Top-k selection by open interest for downsampling, but this rule provides no aggregation error estimate, making risk metrics unauditable. The authors prove that under such target-blind rules the target is not identified, only bounded intervals are possible; they propose probability sampling with inclusion probabilities proportional to open interest, paired with the Hájek ratio estimator and design-based variance estimator to construct approximate intervals for every aggregate. Experiments show the method reduces mean absolute error of OI-weighted implied volatility by 35% at 10% retention and provides narrower intervals.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为带宽受限的金融数据管道提供可审计的误差量化，使下游风险指标更可靠；同时强调纳入概率需匹配目标的影响函数，推动设计感知的生产框架。
keyPointsEn: Deterministic Top-k selection (e.g., by open interest) provides no aggregation error estimate; the target is not identified, only bounded intervals are possible.

Probability sampling with inclusion probabilities proportional to open interest, combined with the Hájek ratio estimator and linearized variance estimator, generates approximate design-based intervals for each aggregate.

On 80 US trading sessions and 83 Hong Kong options sessions, the randomized design reduces mean absolute error of OI-weighted implied volatility by 35%, with intervals significantly narrower than the worst-case intervals of Top-k.
cards.limitations: 研究仅基于美国和中国香港期权市场的特定历史数据，结论可能不适用于其他市场或资产类别；理论结果依赖目标盲规则和有界假设，实际中界可能未知；覆盖率为 91.9%，低于名义 95%，且为近似设计型区间；未讨论计算成本或实施复杂度。
cards.titleEn: Design-Based Intervals for Downsampled Cross-Sectional Market Aggregates in Bandwidth-Constrained Financial Data Pipelines
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method provides auditable error quantification for bandwidth-constrained financial data pipelines, making downstream risk metrics more reliable; it also emphasizes that inclusion probabilities must match the target's influence function, motivating a design-aware production framework.
keyPoints: 确定性 Top-k 选择（如按持仓量）不提供聚合误差估计，目标不可识别，仅能得到有界区间。
概率抽样以持仓量成比例纳入概率，结合 Hájek 比率估计和线性化方差估计，生成每个聚合量的近似设计型区间。
在 80 个美国交易日和 83 个香港期权交易日数据上，随机设计将 OI 加权隐含波动率的平均绝对误差降低 35%，且区间宽度显著窄于 Top-k 的最坏情况区间。
cards.summary: 金融机构常按持仓量确定性选取 Top-k 期权以降采样，但该规则不提供聚合误差估计，导致风险指标不可审计。作者证明此类目标盲规则下目标不可识别，仅能给出有界区间；提出以持仓量成比例的概率抽样结合 Hájek 比率估计和设计型方差估计，为每个聚合量构建近似区间。实验显示该方法在 10% 保留率下将 OI 加权隐含波动率的平均绝对误差降低 35%，并提供更窄的区间。
cards.originalTitle: Approximate Design-Based Intervals for Downsampled Cross-Sectional Market Aggregates: A Randomized Design for Bandwidth-Constrained Financial Data Pipelines
cards.descriptionEn: To address the inability of deterministic Top-k selection to assess aggregation error in downsampled cross-sectional options panels, a design-based interval estimation method using probability sampling is proposed to improve aggregation accuracy and provide error quantification.
cards.description: 针对截面期权面板降采样中确定性 Top-k 选择无法评估聚合误差的问题，提出基于概率抽样的设计型区间估计方法，提升聚合精度并提供误差量化。
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based only on specific historical data from US and Hong Kong options markets; conclusions may not apply to other markets or asset classes; theoretical results rely on target-blind rules and boundedness assumptions, and bounds may be unknown in practice; coverage is 91.9%, below the nominal 95%, and intervals are approximate; computational cost or implementation complexity is not discussed.
cards.title: 基于设计的区间估计优化带宽受限金融数据抽样

cards.summaryEn: To address the inability of standard flat copula structures to capture hierarchical interactions in risk aggregation, the paper proposes a recursive hierarchical copula framework in which dependence is specified locally at each tree node and propagated through recursive rank-based reordering. The authors calibrate copula parameters from empirical data using Kendall's tau and illustrate the method with market and credit risk proxies, assessing robustness across credit segments such as investment-grade and high-yield indices. Numerical results show that dependence strengthens under stress and varies systematically with credit quality, which the authors argue has important implications for risk measurement; these are the paper's claims and have not been independently verified.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法在不同数据与模型设定下稳健，可为VaR与预期短缺等风险度量提供同时具备可解释性和层次结构刻画能力的聚合工具，有助于连接自下而上与自上而下的企业风险管理实践。
keyPointsEn: Proposes a tree-based recursive hierarchical copula aggregation method where dependence is specified locally at nodes and propagated recursively while preserving marginal distributions.
Calibrates copula parameters from empirical data using Kendall's tau and illustrates the approach with market and credit risk proxies and robustness checks across credit segments.

Reports numerical results indicating that dependence strengthens under stress and varies systematically with credit quality, and that tail dependence significantly affects hierarchical aggregation risk.
cards.limitations: 论文的数值证据基于市场与信用风险代理及特定信用分段，依赖Kendall's tau校准和Gaussian、Clayton等Copula选择；文中结果属于示例性展示，并非经同行评审的独立验证，压力下依赖增强与信用质量差异的结论不宜直接外推至所有组合或监管资本场景，且未在原始信息中提供完整数据频率、样本期和统计显著性检验细节。
cards.titleEn: Recursive Hierarchical Copula Aggregation for Market and Credit Portfolio Risk
cards.whyItMattersEn: If robust across different data and model settings, the method could provide a risk aggregation tool for measures such as VaR and Expected Shortfall that is both interpretable and capable of capturing hierarchical structure, helping to connect bottom-up and top-down enterprise risk management practices.
keyPoints: 提出树状递归分层Copula聚合方法，依赖在节点局部指定并递归传播，保持边际分布不变。
使用Kendall's tau从经验数据校准Copula参数，并以市场与信用风险代理及不同信用分段进行示例与稳健性检验。
数值结果表明压力下依赖强度增加且随信用质量系统性变化，并报告尾部依赖对分层聚合风险有显著影响。
cards.summary: 论文针对标准Copula风险聚合依赖平坦结构、难以刻画层次交互的问题，提出递归分层Copula框架，在树的每个聚合节点局部指定依赖并通过基于秩的递归重排传播。作者使用Kendall's tau从经验数据校准Copula参数，并以市场与信用风险代理进行示例，在投资级和高收益等不同信用分段中评估稳健性。数值结果显示压力下依赖强度上升且随信用质量系统性变化，作者认为这对风险计量有重要含义；以上为论文主张，未经独立验证。
cards.originalTitle: Recursive Copula Aggregation for Market and Credit Portfolios
cards.descriptionEn: This paper introduces a tree-based recursive copula aggregation framework that allows dependence to be specified locally at each aggregation node while preserving marginal distributions, capturing hierarchical interactions across risk components better than flat copula structures. It combines copula interpretability with the structural richness of hierarchical models, offering a scalable tool that bridges bottom-up and top-down risk aggregation.
cards.description: 该论文提出一种基于树结构的递归Copula聚合框架，允许在每一聚合节点局部指定依赖关系，同时保持边际分布不变，从而比传统平坦Copula结构更能刻画跨风险组件的层次交互；它结合了Copula可解释性与层次模型的结构丰富性，为自下而上与自上而下的风险聚合提供了可规模化工具。
cards.limitationsEn: The numerical evidence is based on market and credit risk proxies and selected credit segments, relying on Kendall's tau calibration and copula choices such as Gaussian and Clayton; the results are illustrative rather than independently peer-reviewed validation, so conclusions about stress-dependent dependence and credit-quality variation should not be directly extrapolated to all portfolios or regulatory capital settings, and the source does not provide full details on data frequency, sample period, or statistical significance tests.
cards.title: 递归分层Copula聚合市场与信用组合风险

cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces a reward-penalty mechanism into robust portfolio selection when the joint distribution of asset losses is uncertain, aiming to minimize worst-case CVaR. The authors first provide an explicit closed-form expression for worst-case CVaR under the reward-penalty mechanism, which generalizes results such as Jagannathan (1977), Chen et al. (2011), and Cai et al. (2024); they then solve for optimal allocations under classical and generalized mean-covariance distribution sets. Experiments on real market data indicate that the proposed models have the potential to outperform several existing related models, that incorporating downside risk helps manage risk and may achieve higher returns, and that a trade-off exists between expected return and worst-case CVaR control. The empirical findings are the authors' views and require independent verification.
cards.whyItMatters: 为分布不确定环境下的稳健投资组合管理提供了可解析的最坏情况CVaR刻画，并给出了在均值-协方差分布集下的配置方法；同时揭示预期收益与最坏情况CVaR控制之间的权衡，对风险管理和组合优化研究具有参考价值。
keyPointsEn: Derives an explicit closed-form expression for worst-case CVaR under a reward-penalty mechanism, unifying and generalizing several existing models.
Obtains optimal portfolio allocations minimizing worst-case CVaR under both a classical mean-covariance distribution set and the generalized mean-covariance distribution set of Kang et al. (2019).

Real market data experiments suggest the proposed models have the potential to outperform several existing related models, and that incorporating downside risk aids risk management and may improve returns.
cards.limitations: 论文的实证结论基于特定真实市场数据与所选分布集，未说明跨市场、跨时期的稳健性；模型依赖均值-协方差分布集等假设，实际分布偏离时表现可能变化；闭式解的适用条件与数值实现细节需参考原文；实证结果仅为作者报告，不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Worst-case CVaR under a reward-penalty mechanism with applications to robust portfolio management
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides an analytically tractable characterization of worst-case CVaR for robust portfolio management under distribution uncertainty and offers allocation methods under mean-covariance distribution sets; it also highlights the trade-off between expected return and worst-case CVaR control, offering reference value for risk management and portfolio optimization research.
keyPoints: 推导出奖励惩罚机制下最坏情况CVaR的显式闭式表达式，统一并推广了若干已有模型。
在经典均值-协方差分布集和Kang et al. (2019)的广义均值-协方差分布集下，得到最小化最坏情况CVaR的最优投资组合配置。
真实市场数据实验显示，所提模型有潜力优于若干现有相关模型，且纳入下行风险有助于风险管理并可能提高收益。
cards.summary: 论文在资产损失联合分布不确定的设定下，将奖励惩罚机制引入稳健投资组合选择，目标是最小化最坏情况CVaR。作者首先给出最坏情况CVaR的显式闭式表达式，该表达式推广了Jagannathan (1977)、Chen et al. (2011)和Cai et al. (2024)等结果；随后在经典及广义均值-协方差分布集下求解最优配置。作者基于真实市场数据的实验表明，所提模型有潜力优于若干现有模型，纳入下行风险有助于改善风险管理并可能提升收益，且预期收益与最坏情况CVaR控制之间存在权衡。上述实证结果为作者观点，需独立验证。
cards.originalTitle: Conditional value-at-risk under reward-penalty mechanism with applications to robust portfolio management
cards.descriptionEn: This study derives a closed-form expression for worst-case conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) under a reward-penalty mechanism and applies it to robust portfolio management. Its novelty lies in unifying and generalizing several existing worst-case CVaR models while providing an operational robust allocation method.
cards.description: 该研究推导出奖励惩罚机制下最坏情况条件风险价值（CVaR）的闭式解，并将其应用于稳健投资组合管理。新意在于统一并推广了多个已有最坏情况CVaR模型，同时提供可操作的稳健配置方法。
cards.limitationsEn: The empirical conclusions are based on specific real market data and chosen distribution sets, with no evidence of robustness across markets or periods; the models rely on assumptions such as mean-covariance distribution sets, and performance may change when actual distributions deviate; conditions for the closed-form solution and numerical implementation details require consulting the original paper; empirical results are reported by the authors and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.title: 奖励惩罚机制下最坏情况CVaR的稳健投资组合

cards.summaryEn: The research frames iterative problem-solving as a sequential modeling task: at each step, a solver receives feedback and decides how to revise, with the central question being whether performance improves, plateaus, or regresses. The authors curate CodeInsight, covering over 3 million submissions from 3,286 undergraduates in two introductory C++ courses over two academic years, including test-case-level outcomes, timestamps, and source code, and build a benchmark for multiple model classes. Experiments show that an adapted Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) achieves the strongest predictive accuracy on three of four courses; the LLM predictor is less accurate but generates full submissions, and its coding proficiency is inversely related to predictive performance in this setting.
cards.whyItMatters: 该数据集与基准为研究迭代问题解决中的表现变化、错误持续和策略迁移提供了可复用的实证基础，有助于比较不同建模路线在顺序学习任务中的适用性，并推动对人类学习者与自主智能体行为预测的深入理解。
keyPointsEn: CodeInsight contains over 3 million submissions from 3,286 undergraduates across two introductory C++ courses in two academic years, with test-case-level outcomes, timestamps, and source code.

The benchmark compares parametric, sequential, and generative models under a shared calibration-and-scoring protocol, including an adapted Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) and an LLM-based predictor.

The adapted RSSM achieves the highest predictive accuracy on three of four courses; the LLM predictor is less accurate but produces full submissions at each attempt, enabling direct failure-mode analysis.
cards.limitations: 研究仅覆盖两门C++入门课程和两个学年的本科编程场景，结论向其他语言、学科或自主智能体场景的外推需谨慎。数据集需申请获取，可复现性受获取条件限制。LLM预测器精度较低，作者也将其更多理解为受上下文条件驱动的生成式求解器，而非对求解者行为的忠实预测器；RSSM的优势基于特定基准与评分协议，尚无跨数据集验证。
cards.titleEn: CodeInsight: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Modeling Iterative Problem-Solving in Programming
cards.whyItMattersEn: The dataset and benchmark provide a reusable empirical foundation for studying performance changes, error persistence, and strategy shifts in iterative problem-solving, helping compare different modeling approaches in sequential learning tasks and advancing understanding of behavior prediction for human learners and autonomous agents.
keyPoints: CodeInsight包含超300万次提交、3286名本科生、2门C++课程和2个学年的数据，附测试用例级结果、时间戳与源码。
基准在统一校准与评分协议下比较参数化、顺序化和生成式模型，包括适配的循环状态空间模型（RSSM）与基于LLM的预测器。
适配RSSM在四门课程中的三门预测精度最高；LLM预测器精度较低但可生成每次尝试的完整提交，便于直接分析失败模式。
cards.summary: 研究将迭代解题视为顺序建模任务，在每次尝试中求解者根据反馈决定如何修改方案，核心是预测表现会提升、停滞还是回退。作者整理了CodeInsight数据集，覆盖两门C++入门课程、两个学年、3286名学生的超300万次提交，包含测试用例级结果、时间戳与源码，并构建基准评测多类模型。实验发现适配的循环状态空间模型在四门课程中的三门取得最高预测精度；LLM预测器精度较低但能生成完整提交，其编程能力与该场景下的预测表现呈反向关系。
cards.originalTitle: A Dataset for Modeling Iterative Problem-Solving
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces CodeInsight, a dataset of over 3 million submissions from 3,286 undergraduates across two introductory C++ courses in two academic years, with test-case-level outcomes, timestamps, and source code. It builds a benchmark under a shared calibration-and-scoring protocol to compare parametric, sequential, and generative models for predicting iterative problem-solving performance, offering a new basis for understanding sequential learning in human learners an
cards.description: 该研究构建了包含3286名本科生、超300万次提交的C++编程数据集，并建立统一评测协议，比较参数化、序列化与生成式模型在预测迭代解题表现上的差异，为理解人类学习者与自主智能体的顺序学习机制提供新基准。
cards.limitationsEn: The study covers only two introductory C++ courses and two academic years in undergraduate programming settings, so extrapolation to other languages, subjects, or autonomous agent scenarios requires caution. The dataset is available on request, which may limit reproducibility. The LLM predictor is less accurate, and the authors interpret it more as a generative solver conditioned on context than as a faithful predictor of solver behavior; the RSSM advantage is based on a specific benchmark and scoring protocol and lacks cross-dataset validation.
cards.title: CodeInsight：追踪编程迭代解题过程的大规模数据集与基准

cards.summaryEn: A paired experiment with 43 laptop products and 86 runs compares hierarchical and flat LLM agent teams writing open-ended business-intelligence reports. Fact: flat teams score higher on Utility and Writing Clarity, while hierarchical reports have the same length but use 53% more hedging words, and each revision is linked to a 0.14-point drop in Writing Clarity. Author view: authority improves quality when the manager can verify work, but has a negative effect when it can only provide feedback.
cards.whyItMatters: 该发现挑战了多智能体大模型框架默认让经理拥有退回修改权的设计假设，提示在开放式、难以验证的任务中，层级授权可能损害输出质量，为团队协调机制设计提供实验依据。
keyPointsEn: Flat teams outperform hierarchical teams on Utility (d = 0.42, p = 0.009) and Writing Clarity (d = 0.34, p = 0.030).
The hierarchical team's first draft is indistinguishable from the flat team's report; the quality gap can be traced to revision.
Hierarchical reports use 53% more hedging words, and each revision is associated with a 0.14-point drop in Writing Clarity on a 1 to 5 scale.
cards.limitations: 实验仅覆盖商业智能报告这一开放式任务，样本为43对笔记本电脑产品、86次运行，结论推广至其他任务类型需谨慎。研究未直接检验其他领域或更复杂层级结构，且质量评分依赖特定指标，未涉及长期或实际业务影响。
cards.titleEn: Loop-Back Authority Degrades Report Quality in LLM Agent Teams
cards.whyItMattersEn: This finding challenges the default design assumption in multi-agent LLM frameworks that gives managers loop-back revision authority, suggesting that in open-ended, hard-to-verify tasks, hierarchical authority may harm output quality and offering experimental evidence for coordination-mechanism design.
keyPoints: 扁平团队报告在效用（d=0.42，p=0.009）与写作清晰度（d=0.34，p=0.030）上优于层级团队。
层级团队首稿与扁平团队报告无法区分，质量差距可追溯到修改环节。
层级团队报告使用模糊限制词多53%，每次修改对应写作清晰度下降0.14分（1至5分制）。
cards.summary: 研究通过43对笔记本电脑产品、86次运行的配对实验，比较层级团队与扁平团队撰写开放式商业智能报告。事实是扁平团队报告在效用和写作清晰度上得分更高，层级团队报告长度相同但多53%的模糊限制词，每次修改对应写作清晰度下降0.14分。作者观点认为，当经理能验证工作时授权提升质量，否则仅能提供反馈时授权产生负面影响。
cards.originalTitle: Loop-Back Authority in LLM Agent Teams: A Paired Experiment on Flat and Hierarchical Coordination
cards.descriptionEn: The novelty lies in showing that in an open-ended business-intelligence reporting task, hierarchical teams where a manager can send back worker output for revision produce lower-quality reports; they score lower on Utility and Writing Clarity and use more hedging words than flat teams. This provides counter-evidence to the default manager-revision authority in multi-agent LLM frameworks.
cards.description: 新发现在于：在开放式商业智能报告任务中，层级团队授权经理将工人输出退回修改，反而降低报告质量；相比扁平团队，其效用与写作清晰度得分更低，且报告使用更多模糊限制词。这为多智能体框架默认设置经理修改权提供了反面证据。
cards.limitationsEn: The experiment covers only business-intelligence reporting as an open-ended task, with a sample of 43 laptop products and 86 runs, so generalization to other task types requires caution. The study does not directly test other domains or more complex hierarchies, and quality ratings rely on specific metrics without addressing long-term or real-world business impact.
cards.title: 回环授权让大模型团队报告质量下降

cards.summaryEn: The authors contend that in interactive environments such as autonomous driving, constraining distribution shift only in the policy's own action space is insufficient, because a candidate ego trajectory may be well supported marginally but poorly supported jointly with surrounding-agent behavior in the logged interaction. They introduce interaction distribution shift (IDS) and show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. ICDP recovers the latter via contrastive density-ratio estimation, avoiding explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or reactive simulator rollouts.
cards.whyItMatters: 对自动驾驶等安全关键离线强化学习场景，该工作提示仅约束自车动作分布可能遗漏交互层面的不可靠估计；若验证成立，ICDP提供了一种无需额外预测或模拟的交互级约束机制，可能减少高价值但不可执行的轨迹选择。
keyPointsEn: Introduces interaction distribution shift (IDS): insufficient joint support between ego trajectories and surrounding agents' futures, beyond policy action-space shift.
Joint-support degradation decomposes into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component.
ICDP recovers interaction compatibility via contrastive density-ratio estimation, requiring no joint density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or simulator rollouts.
cards.limitations: 证据基于nuPlan、InterPlan和真实卡车实验，但摘要未披露具体指标、统计显著性与失败案例。ICDP依赖对比密度比估计恢复交互支撑，其准确性受离线数据覆盖与估计质量影响；文中未讨论极端分布外交互或安全保证。结论为学术实验范围内的性能改进，不构成投资或部署建议。
cards.titleEn: Interaction-Constrained Offline RL for Autonomous Driving Distribution Shift
cards.whyItMattersEn: For safety-critical offline reinforcement learning in autonomous driving, this work indicates that constraining only ego action distributions may miss interaction-level unreliable value estimates. If validated, ICDP offers an interaction-level constraint without extra prediction or simulation, potentially reducing high-value but infeasible trajectory selections.
keyPoints: 提出交互分布偏移（IDS）：自车轨迹与周围智能体未来联合支撑不足，而非仅策略动作空间偏移。
联合支撑退化可分解为自车支撑分量与残差交互支撑分量。
ICDP通过对比密度比估计恢复交互兼容性，无需联合密度建模、周围智能体预测或模拟器rollout。
cards.summary: 作者认为，在自动驾驶等交互环境中，仅约束策略自身动作空间的分布偏移不足以保证离线强化学习的安全与有效，因为候选自车轨迹可能边际支撑良好但与日志中周围智能体行为联合支撑差。为此提出交互分布偏移（IDS）概念，并证明联合支撑退化可精确分解为自车支撑与残差交互支撑两部分。ICDP利用对比密度比估计恢复残差交互支撑，避免显式联合密度建模、周围智能体预测或反应式模拟器。
cards.originalTitle: Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
cards.descriptionEn: This work argues that offline reinforcement learning for autonomous driving must control not only policy action-space distribution shift but also degradation in joint support between ego and surrounding agents' futures, termed interaction distribution shift (IDS). The authors propose ICDP, a framework that recovers a residual interaction-support component via contrastive density-ratio estimation from the joint data distribution, suppressing high-value yet interaction-unsuppor
cards.description: 该工作指出离线强化学习在自动驾驶中不仅需控制自车动作的策略分布偏移，还需控制自车与周围智能体未来轨迹联合支撑的退化，称为交互分布偏移（IDS）。作者提出ICDP框架，通过对比密度比估计从联合数据分布中恢复残差交互支撑分量，无需联合密度建模或反应式模拟器即可在策略优化中抑制高价值但交互不支持的轨迹选择。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on nuPlan, InterPlan and real-world truck experiments, but the summary lacks concrete metrics, statistical significance and failure cases. ICDP relies on contrastive density-ratio estimation to recover interaction support, whose accuracy depends on offline data coverage and estimation quality; extreme out-of-distribution interactions or safety guarantees are not discussed. Conclusions are academic performance improvements within experimental scope and do not constitute investment or deployment advice.
cards.title: 交互约束离线强化学习应对驾驶分布偏移

cards.summaryEn: The source states that Reachy Mini is an open-source desktop robot by Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face, and the video's motions were recorded from a real robot. The publisher says the entire film is a web page that can be played, scrubbed, and forked. These are source claims; no quantitative metrics or third-party verification are provided.
cards.whyItMatters: 该发布把机器人硬件演示与可交互网页、开源代码分发结合起来，降低了开发者了解和复现桌面机器人动作效果的入口门槛，也展示了开源社区在机器人内容传播上的实践方式。
keyPointsEn: Reachy Mini is presented as an open-source desktop robot by Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face.
The source claims the motions in the video come from a real Reachy Mini recording, not pure animation.
The film is released as a Hugging Face Spaces web page supporting playback, scrubbing, and code forking.
cards.limitations: 内容来源为 Hugging Face 页面描述与 YouTube 视频，缺乏动作精度、延迟、成本或性能数据；无法据此判断技术成熟度或适用场景。视频为音乐短片形式，不代表产品评测或研究结论。
cards.titleEn: Reachy Mini Open-Source Desktop Robot Music Video Release
cards.whyItMattersEn: This release combines a robot hardware demo with an interactive web page and open-source code distribution, lowering the entry barrier for developers to understand and reproduce desktop robot motion effects and illustrating open-source community practices in robotics content dissemination.
keyPoints: Reachy Mini 由 Pollen Robotics 与 Hugging Face 合作推出，定位开源桌面机器人。
短片中的机器人动作据来源称来自真实 Reachy Mini 录制，非纯动画。
影片以 Hugging Face Spaces 网页形式发布，支持播放、拖动与复制代码。
cards.summary: 来源称 Reachy Mini 是 Pollen Robotics 与 Hugging Face 推出的开源桌面机器人，视频中动作来自真实机器人录制。发布方表示整部短片就是网页，可播放、拖动进度并复制代码。这些属于来源方陈述；尚无数值指标或第三方验证。
cards.originalTitle: Reachy Mini - Yo It's Your Boy (music video)
cards.descriptionEn: This content presents a demonstration of Reachy Mini, an open-source desktop robot by Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face, delivered as an interactive web page with real robot motions. Its novelty lies in combining robot motion with a web-based interactive medium; its usefulness is in offering developers reusable demo code and platform reference.
cards.description: 该内容展示 Pollen Robotics 与 Hugging Face 合作的开源桌面机器人 Reachy Mini 的技术演示，以可交互网页形式呈现真实机器人的动作。新意在于将机器人动作捕捉与网络可交互媒体结合；有用之处是为开发者提供可复制、可修改的演示代码与平台参考。
cards.limitationsEn: The content comes from a Hugging Face page description and a YouTube video, lacking data on motion precision, latency, cost, or performance; it cannot be used to judge technical maturity or applicable scenarios. The video is a music short rather than a product review or research conclusion.
cards.title: Reachy Mini 开源桌面机器人的音乐视频发布

cards.summaryEn: The project positions itself as 'Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.' This description reflects the author's stated goal and vision, not a verified research finding. The input contains no implementation mechanisms, performance evaluations, or usability evidence.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方向可行，可能降低逆向工程中人工分析的门槛，但当前仅为项目定位，尚不能判断实际效用。
keyPointsEn: The project aims to use agents for reverse engineering tasks.
The reverse-engineering scope is described as from app behavior to native binaries.
